Data:N.saint.dreams.diverted.json.label: The Dreams Diverted
Data:N.saint.dreams.diverted.json.desc: The dreams that the wooden saint brings have been pent safely in the Mansus.

Data:N.saint.drowned.json.label: The Drowned Saint
Data:N.saint.drowned.json.desc: The miraculous wooden image in the Strasbourg church was drowned in the river.

Data:N.saint.extirpated.json.label: The Cross Afire
Data:N.saint.extirpated.json.desc: The wooden saint is forgotten, and its inheritance will likely join it in the flames.

Data:N.saint.json.label: The Sandalwood Saint
Data:N.saint.json.desc: What happened to the miraculous wooden image in the Strasbourg church?

Data:N.saint.redder.json.label: The Church of the Redder Sun
Data:N.saint.redder.json.desc: A new Church of the Redder Sun has germinated; one that will honour the inheritance of the wooden saint-image.

Data:N.skin.captured.arthur.safe.json.label: Safety for Arthur
Data:N.skin.captured.arthur.safe.json.desc: Arthur imprisoned the labhite Abecassis - but he is safe from Echidna's vengeance.

Data:N.skin.captured.json.label: The Labyrinth's Prisoner
Data:N.skin.captured.json.desc: Lt Moore has made Abecassis, the altered labhite, a prisoner of the Labyrinth. Abecassis had been suckling from Echidna, the Mother of Monsters - and Echidna has been angered by his capture.

Data:N.skin.captured.punished.json.label: Arthur's Punishment
Data:N.skin.captured.punished.json.desc: The Librarian rarely intervenes in the matters of the wider world, but now and then it is necessary. Echidna has taken her vengeance upon Arthur, for Arthur's imprisonment of the labhite Abecassis. Arthur is gone, but Echidna can be summoned to lend her services to the Lighthouse Institute.

Data:N.skin.free.byezack.json.label: Zachary, Adieu
Data:N.skin.free.byezack.json.desc: Zachary learnt lessons of change from the business with Abecassis - and now he is gone into the sky with the travelling-kinds of the Cross. He has, perhaps, been saved from something much worse.

Data:N.skin.free.concluded.json.label: A Shed Skin
Data:N.skin.free.concluded.json.desc: The labhite Abecassis is seen no more. Most likely he's joined Echidna's retinue. Zachary remains.

Data:N.skin.free.json.label: Abecassis at Large
Data:N.skin.free.json.desc: The altered labhite Abecassis is free in the world, for good or for ill.

Data:N.skin.json.label: Abecassis?
Data:N.skin.json.desc: What happened to Abecassis the Labhite?

Data:N.skin.slain.azita.json.label: Azita's Duty
Data:N.skin.slain.azita.json.desc: The labhite Abecassis is dead, slain by Azita in service to the Colonel. Abecassis had been suckling from Echidna, the Mother of Monsters - and Echidna isn't impressed by Azita's intervention.

Data:N.skin.slain.azita.punished.json.label: Azita's Punishment
Data:N.skin.slain.azita.punished.json.desc: The Librarian rarely intervenes in the matters of the wider world, but now and then it is necessary. Echidna has taken her vengeance upon Azita, for Azita's slaying of the labhite Abecassis. Azita is gone, but Echidna can be summoned to lend her services to the Lighthouse Institute.

Data:N.skin.slain.azita.safe.json.label: Safety for Azita
Data:N.skin.slain.azita.safe.json.desc: Azita slew the labhite Abecassis - but she is safe from Echidna's vengeance.

Data:N.skin.slain.chaima.json.label: Chaima's Mercy
Data:N.skin.slain.chaima.json.desc: The labhite Abecassis is dead, slain by Chaima as an act of grim mercy. Abecassis had been suckling from Echidna, the Mother of Monsters - and Echidna isn't impressed by Chaima's intervention.

Data:N.skin.slain.chaima.punished.json.label: Chaima's Punishment
Data:N.skin.slain.chaima.punished.json.desc: The Librarian rarely intervenes in the matters of the wider world, but now and then it is necessary. Echidna has taken her vengeance upon Chaima, for Chaima's slaying of the labhite Abecassis. Chaima is gone, but Echidna can be summoned to lend her services to the Lighthouse Institute.

Data:N.skin.slain.chaima.safe.json.label: Safety for Chaima
Data:N.skin.slain.chaima.safe.json.desc: Chaima slew the labhite Abecassis - but she is safe from Echidna's vengeance.

Data:N.tapestry.concluded.json.label: Gladwyn's Silence
Data:N.tapestry.concluded.json.desc: Whatever mysteries could be found in the Friar's Tapestry are abandoned to the depths of Gladwyn Lake.

Data:N.tapestry.connie.disillusioned.jso.label: Up by the Roots
Data:N.tapestry.connie.disillusioned.jso.desc: The Haustorium has entered into a formal arrangement with the Suppression Bureau. Connie Lee, profoundly unhappy with the arrangement, did her best to expose it, and then fled to find a new life.

Data:N.tapestry.connie.reaffirmed.json.label: Deep Roots
Data:N.tapestry.connie.reaffirmed.json.desc: The Haustorium has entered into a formal arrangement with the Suppression Bureau. Connie Lee, although profoundly unhappy with the arrangement, has made her peace with it and continues to serve at the Bureau.

Data:N.tapestry.investigated.json.label: The Insinuating Filaments
Data:N.tapestry.investigated.json.desc: The business at Gladwyn Lake was the work of the Haustorium - a noble institution that 'preserves what would not otherwise be preserved', or a 'creepy pack of Peruvian fungus-wizards', depending on preference. Intentionally or not, this has brought the Haustorium and the Suppression Bureau into a new alliance, to the great unhappiness of Connie Lee.

Data:N.tapestry.json.label: The Friar's Tapestry
Data:N.tapestry.json.desc: What happened up at Gladwyn Lake?

Data:N.wood.assisted.complete.json.label: The God in the Hive
Data:N.wood.assisted.complete.json.desc: Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. The authorities' investigation of her health camp had forced her to close, but with Father Stanislav's help, the scheme will continue. For now, it remains in hibernation at Hush House.

Data:N.wood.assisted.json.label: The God in pectore
Data:N.wood.assisted.json.desc: Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. The authorities' investigation of her health camp had forced her to close, but with Father Stanislav's help - and perhaps that of Hush House - the scheme will continue.

Data:N.wood.assisted.refused.json.label: The God in Exile
Data:N.wood.assisted.refused.json.desc: Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. The authorities' investigation of her health camp had forced her to close. With Father Stanislav's help the scheme might continue, but Hush House will not host it.

Data:N.wood.concluded.json.label: The Sleeping God
Data:N.wood.concluded.json.desc: Whatever was happening in the Black Forest, remains in the Black Forest.

Data:N.wood.discouraged.json.label: The God Discouraged
Data:N.wood.discouraged.json.desc: Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. The authorities' investigation of her health camp has forced her to close, but she may continue somewhere else…

Data:N.wood.investigated.json.label: The God Awakened
Data:N.wood.investigated.json.desc: Liselotte has been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind at the Lyterion. Is that bad?

Data:N.wood.json.label: The God in the Wood
Data:N.wood.json.desc: Has anything more happened at the health camp in the Black Forest that called itself the 'Lyterion'?

Data:N.wood.prevented.json.label: The God Abolished
Data:N.wood.prevented.json.desc: Liselotte had been 'exalting' willing humans with the implantation of the larval Blomberende-kind. Now that Kitling Ripe's attention has been drawn to these tasty hybrid treats, the scheme is doomed.

Data:Name.earthquake.json.Label: Earthquake Name
Data:Name.earthquake.json.Desc: Everything comes when it is called - even the nightmares that trouble stone's deep sleep.

Data:Nectar.json.label: Nectar
Data:Nectar.json.desc: The green wealth in the world's veins; the pulse of the seasons. [Long ago, some called this principle Blood.]

Data:Nectar.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Nectar.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]

Data:Newspaper.yellowing.json.Label: Yellowing Newspaper
Data:Newspaper.yellowing.json.Desc: It's dated the year that Hush House was abandoned.

xexts.scrutiny: Nothing's history when first it happens…
